Resolves #4548

`Neo.dialog.Base#show()` and `#hide()` now follow the `component.Base` visibility contract:
- Both write `hidden`, so Escape closes a dialog reopened with `show()`.
- A dialog mounts in one flight at a time. An animated `show()` no longer runs again on a mounted dialog, which used to insert a second node with the same id.
- A hide during a mount lands on the hide, instead of sending a `removeNode` for a node that does not exist yet.
- An explicit `autoMount: false` / `autoInitVnode: false` holds without an `animateTargetId`.
- A modal dialog's mask leaves the page with the dialog, also when a hide lands with an animated show's mount flight.

How:
- The non-animated paths call `super`.
- The animated show is held as the mount flight through `component.Base#startMountFlight()`. That method is extracted from `component.Base#show()`, so the landing rule stays in one place.
- `component.Base#unmount()` returns its `removeNode` promise, and `Dialog#unmount()` syncs the mask once the node is gone. `Neo.main.DomAccess#syncModalMask` keys the mask to the dialogs in the DOM, so a sync that runs before removal keeps it.

Evidence: L3 (real browser on `examples/stateProvider/dialog`, old code against this branch; unit arms on the real `Neo.dialog.Base`) → L2 required (App-worker visibility state and mount bookkeeping). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- **One close target.** #4547 ("show/hide do not adjust the hidden config") is fixed by the same change and was closed as a duplicate of #4548. Its acceptance is AC-1 of the [intake contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/4548#issuecomment-6682116394), which also adds the animated path and the `autoMount` opt-out to the 2023 body.
- **New `component.Base#startMountFlight()`.** This is `component.Base#show()`'s own flight-and-landing code, moved into a protected method so Dialog's animated show reuses it instead of copying it.
- **Dialogs inside a container.** A Dialog whose `parentId` is not `document.body` now shows and hides through its parent's vdom, as any component does, instead of mounting a second root.
  - No engine app does this: every one creates its Dialog standalone. The #6600 email demo (#20447) does, with a Dashboard-owned compose host.
  - The arm "a dialog its parent renders shows and hides through the parent, never mounting itself" pins this path. It is red on `dev`, where the reopen mounts the dialog itself.
  - An animated show still mounts the dialog itself, so a dialog its parent renders should not set an `animateTargetId`.
- **The #20447 follow-up (recorded on #4548).** #20447 merged first, so this PR deletes `Email.view.ComposeDialog#afterSetAnimateTargetId`, which existed only to work around AC-4. It also rewrites the `apps/email/EPIC_PLAN.md` paragraph about it, and names the compose overlay's instant show/hide in the class JSDoc. `EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs` in the Brain-gated tier is the real-app witness that the dashboard still renders the composer.

Out of scope, noted in defect-notes:
- `animateHide()` undoes a `show()` that arrives during its ~300 ms animation.
- An auto-mounting `document.body` component created `hidden: true` still mounts, because `initVnode()` deletes the root's `removeDom`.
- A modal dialog with the default `closeAction: 'close'` that closes through `animateHide()` leaves its mask: `close(false)` destroys the dialog and nothing syncs the mask afterwards. The path is unchanged from `dev`; the spec's first draft of its control hit it.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** A modal hidden after its node inserts but before its animated show settles leaves the page covered by an orphan mask.

At `b088d1f456236475ef6e1c7d7544681506ddb714`, I ran native Chromium against the actual Engine component empty viewport, real App worker and real DOM, with no Brain:

1. Create a Button opener and a standalone Dialog with `animateTargetId` pointing to it, `autoShow:false, hidden:true, modal:true, closeAction:'hide'`.
2. Set `hidden:false`; wait for the dialog DOM to attach.
3. Immediately set `hidden:true`; wait for dialog detachment and allow the mask synchronization to settle.

| Same native setup | Dialog after hide | Modal dialogs | Mask | Center hit target | Page errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Control: show settles before hide | absent | 0 | absent | underlying button | none |
| Hide during show | absent | 0 | present | `neo-dialog-modal-mask` | none |

Production path: `dialog/Base.mjs:615–617` syncs while the deferred node still exists; `animateShow:477–480` skips its final sync when hidden; `component/Base.mjs:1998–2000` then unmounts without a Dialog mask sync. `DomAccess.syncModalMask:1479–1497` keys the mask to DOM presence. Neither `DeltaUpdates.removeNode` nor the mutation observer compensates.

The new unit arm hides before a modeled mount and stubs `syncModalMask` globally, so it cannot detect this native interleaving. An independent exact-method probe found the same ordering before the browser confirmed it.
